table.definition: w(e) = 1 for every realized record-write event
each world carrying at least one event gets equal mass 1/|supported worlds|, spread uniformly over its own events
world mass proportional to its clean-dwell occupation count, uniform within the world

formation-moment weighting, LIFETIME reading: world mass proportional to (total boundaries - formation moment + 1), the number of horizon moments in which the world is already formed; uniform within the world; never-formed worlds get zero
formation-moment weighting, ELAPSED reading: world mass proportional to the formation moment itself; uniform within the world; worlds formed at moment 0 and never-formed worlds get zero
uniform absolute mass on the escape orbit: every world of the free (never-formed-free) orbit gets equal mass, spread uniformly over its own events; every other world gets zero

P_A_result.why: additivity makes I a sum of event weights; content determination makes the weight a function of the content cell; so I(A) = sum over cells c of n_A(c) * w(c), which depends on A only through its content multiset.  The difference functional I(A) - I(B) for a content-preserving pair has an identically zero coefficient vector, checked exhaustively over every multi-event content cell.

P_B_result.why_not: the landed sentences constrain the SHAPE of a readout (additive, content-determined) but select no particular one.  The admissible probabilities form a simplex of affine dimension 52017, so the record frequencies are not fixed by the sentences.

C4_RESIDUE_VECTORS.question: how many DISTINCT residue vectors do the 1,404 recipes' escape-world sum vectors take?  That number, not 1404, is the effective count of independent tries the survey made at the denominator lemma's arithmetic gate.

stated_checks.DISCREPANCY: the two stated null numbers do not come from one model.  0.00539 is the PER-PRIME-POWER model at degree 0; 85.8 is the SINGLE-MODULUS model at degree 2.  Applied consistently, model A expects 414.72 degree-2 passes (observed 188 native), which is an UNDER-hit, not an over-hit; model B expects 0.81 degree-0 passes.  The '189-vs-85.8 over-hit' is an artifact of mixing models.

C4_RESIDUE_VECTORS.what_this_does_to_909s_empirical_claim: THE EVIDENCE IS REAL BUT DEFLATED: the 1404 recipes realize 853 distinct residue vectors mod 613 (0.608 of the headline count), so the survey made roughly that many genuinely independent tries at the 613 gate -- not 1,404, but not a handful either.  The empirical arm of 909's claim survives at reduced strength; it is not the load-bearing arm.  Decisively, ZERO of the 1,404 native recipes pass the degree-0 filter (observed 0 against 7.57 expected under the per-prime-power null), so the survey found no realizer not because it got lucky but because the arithmetic gate is genuinely hard to hit; and since the lemma depends only on the world sums, it kills every profile built on those sums whether or not it lies in the declared closure.  The lemma, not the survey, is what makes further search useless.
